up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows corresponding to IC50 measurements with non-null pChEMBL values for the human target CHEMBL223 (Alpha-1D adrenergic receptor). The query must filter for exact standard relation '=' and include only rows where pChEMBL value is not null. Required output columns are: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays table), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary or activities), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (from activities). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the result to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID", target_dictionary.target_type AS "target type", target_dictionary.tax_id AS "tax_id", compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID", activities.standard_type AS "standard type", activities.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value" FROM assays JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN activities ON assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL223' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
